name: Nakuru

queries.query: Nakuru Kenya official land registry cadastral parcel map GIS county land information management system
queries.scope: Find a local custodian, public parcel-map entry point, and safe geometry interface.
queries.result: The official national registry directory lists Nakuru Land Registry at Ardhi House, Moi Road, with land registration, adjudication, administration, valuation, survey and mapping services. Nakuru County describes a developing Land Information Management System, but no anonymous public cadastral feature layer/schema was found. Ardhisasa is an account-based land-service portal; no sign-in or record search was attempted.
queries.executionMethod: Separate English-language web search; official public source review.
